ItemID: unavailable; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought repair supplies, but I have no current need for an assortment of locking nuts.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy, 5 Minute Set, .85 Ounce Syringe, Clear, (Pack of 1); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A small epoxy pack fits my interest in practical repairs and complements the tape and vinyl cement I have used.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: No. 6 x 1/2" Stainless Truss Head Phillips Wood Screw, (100 pc), 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel Sheet Metal Screws, Type A Point, Plain Finish by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a project requiring this exact screw size before choosing a hundred of them.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Super Glue 15187 , Clear- pack of 12; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Twelve tubes exceed my current repair needs, and I would choose the small epoxy pack this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rocaris 80Pcs 1" (25mm) Abrasive Wheel Buffing Polishing Wheel Set for Rotary Tool…; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases do not suggest a polishing task or a rotary tool that needs these accessories.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: XHF 1-1/4 Inch (30mm) 3:1 Waterproof Heat Shrink Tubing Marine Grade Wire Cable Adhesive Lined Tube Insulation Seal Against Moisture Corrosion and Air Leakage, 4 Ft Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Wire insulation is relevant to my connector purchase, but I cannot justify this particular large tubing size right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Loctite 908570 2.7 oz Tub Clear Silicone Waterproof Sealant, Single Tube; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A small tube interests me for sealing gaps around the ducting and hose connections suggested by my clamp purchases.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would choose the small clear epoxy this time; I have no specific metal repair requiring steel-reinforced epoxy.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The adhesive is relevant, but ten containers are more than I would use for occasional repairs.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying clamps and connectors does not give me a current metal-cutting need or establish that I own a compatible tool.
